note: Production bugs found by docs/test-results/production-smoke-regression/round-N.md (production rounds). Read by scripts/production-rounds.mjs: the tracker sync adds each to its owning feature; only a later production round verifies it. Fictional/public data only.

bugs.expected: POST /mcp with no token: HTTP 401, JSON error, WWW-Authenticate Bearer (the platform MCP server)
bugs.actual: HTTP 404 text/html "Page not found" from Netlify; the request never reaches Render
bugs.rootCause: saltbasin.net is served by Netlify (netlify.toml); only /api/* is proxied to Render. /mcp is mounted outside /api, so on production no agent can reach the MCP server at all.

bugs.expected: page response X-Robots-Tag "noindex, nofollow, noarchive", Referrer-Policy no-referrer, meta robots noindex
bugs.actual: page X-Robots-Tag absent, Referrer-Policy absent, meta robots absent (API response does carry X-Robots-Tag)
bugs.rootCause: The /r/ and /release-tracker/ privacy headers are set only by Express (server/index.js); Netlify serves the HTML, so they never apply. netlify.toml has no [[headers]] for these paths. The missing meta follows from P2.
